asset_set: Questionnaire Q16 option 2 — Documenting wildlife behavior

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under notebook and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; faint grain lines on notebook cover via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: quiet curious field-science energy — approachable naturalist hobby, not sterile lab
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint cool #F0F4FF highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: violet appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on binocular barrel and pencil tip
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under notebook and hands

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: steadies the binoculars and turns the focus dial
left_hand.grip: cupped palm around the barrel, thumb on dial
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: sketches a bird silhouette into the field notebook
right_hand.position: center-right, hovering over the notebook page

pose.gesture_summary: mid-observation freeze frame — pencil mid-stroke on a fresh sketch
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: folded, resting on the notebook cover — not worn on a face

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands fine-tunes a pair of binoculars while the other sketches a bird's silhouette into a field notebook, capturing a quiet moment of observation at a soft grassy horizon. The scene reads as patient field science, not a sterile lab.

primary_objects.name: binoculars
primary_objects.detail: focus dial mid-turn, violet-tinted lens rims

primary_objects.name: field notebook
primary_objects.detail: simple pencil sketch of a bird silhouette, no readable text

primary_objects.name: pencil
primary_objects.size_relative: small — resting in right hand grip
primary_objects.detail: worn tip, mid-stroke on the page

primary_objects.name: bird silhouettes
primary_objects.detail: two simple birds in soft-focus background, no fine detail

subject.environment: grassy field edge strip across bottom third fading to a soft horizon line — no sky detail, no wall

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from binoculars → gaze direction → notebook sketch
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 40px safe zone for card crop
composition.thumbnail_readability: notebook silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter I, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, hunting weapon, trapped or injured animal, guns, blood
